preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string can be empty.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' if len(msg) == 0 else len(stdout) == len(set(stdout))
postconditions.description: The output is an empty string if the input is empty, otherwise, the output contains unique characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in msg for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output must be present in the input string.
The output characters are sorted from highest to lowest.
